title: Vow and Garden
author: Marguerite Joubert
blurb: Lena Voss, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
